scope: 同一R13基础体的动作气质检查，不新增形态或装备，不代表动画/命中/受击规则完成。
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE Unbranded One mecha full-body action source illustration, same R13 robot, signature reverse rising punch.

Input 1 is the SOLE exact identity master. Preserve this specific robot's head, tall adult proportions, shoulder geometry, chest architecture, armor panels, forearm rails, fingers, hip panels, knees, boots and palette. Do not redesign it or add armor. This is the SAME basic mass-production robot becoming heroic through its body mechanics, framing and conviction.

KEEP:
Small faceted teal helmet, two straight rearward temple antennae. The ivory dorsal crest has a SOLID WHITE CENTRAL SPINE and TWO narrow GOLD SIDE CHANNELS, plus separate little lower gold forehead insert. Thin continuous amber visor and smooth ivory faceplate.
Ivory/teal stepped shoulder plates, exposed round gold shoulder couplings, petrol-teal chest center, paired rectangular ochre louver blocks, charcoal abdomen. Same two practical ochre outer-forearm striking rails and gold knuckle plates. Same long ivory thighs, faceted ivory/teal shins, gold kneecap details and compact gold-capped boots. No emblem or royal regalia.
Exactly two connected arms and two connected legs. Hands have normal five-finger structure. No third arm or fist.

ACTION:
A forceful grounded martial-arts RISING UPPERCUT, executed by the robot's anatomical RIGHT arm. Show the moment when it has absorbed a blow and now steps INTO the counterattack: left lead foot planted firmly, bent left knee, rear right leg drives from the ground with its heel lifting; hips rotate, torso rises through a strong diagonal; RIGHT elbow bent about 100-120 degrees, RIGHT fist drives forward and upward to slightly above eye level, knuckles oriented along the strike path. The RIGHT arm is in the near foreground at camera-left. The other LEFT arm stays tucked in a guard near the side of the ribcage, its hand clearly separate. Head remains visible behind and beside the punching forearm, visor fixed along the punch path. This is not a victory salute, straight-arm sky pose, airborne Superman flight, kneeling pose or sword swing.
The strong silhouette comes from planted foot -> hip -> torso -> elbow -> fist, not gigantic added gloves. Perspective may emphasize the near fist modestly, but do not double its actual size or alter the gold forearm structure.
Serious and decisive, not angry monster or comical mascot. The ordinary machine can carry the frame as the hero, without becoming the ornate King.

COMPOSITION:
Full body, single robot only, dynamic three-quarter view with a modest low camera and controlled perspective. Leave clear separation around the right fist, left guarding hand and face; all extremities inside canvas with 6% margin. Large directional ink lines and two or three restrained pale warm motion arcs can support the punch, kept clear of the face and identity panels. No opponent, no invented damage, no text, no logos, no HUD, no new energy cannons, wings, sword, shield, drill, cape, crown prongs, hair, explosive aura or transformations.
Same crisp KINETIC_CEL linework and two-step cell shadows as the master, strong ivory/teal large color blocks with ochre accents, graphite joints. More purposeful directional light, but no bloom, photoreal texture or 3D toy rendering. Actual transparent background; no checkerboard, colored fog, floor, drop shadow, poster or frame.
